question: Which {SNP} serves as the lead {QTL} for {@gene_symbol@}?
general - relationship - specific.cyper_for_intermediate_page: MATCH (variant:sequence_variant:snp)-[r:fine_mapped_eQTL]->(gene:coding_elements {id:'@gene@'}) WITH CASE WHEN r.data_source='GTEx; SusieR' THEN 'GTEx; SusieR' WHEN r.data_source='INSPIRE; SusieR' THEN 'INSPIRE; SusieR' WHEN r.data_source='splicing; GTEx' THEN 'splicing; GTEx' WHEN r.data_source='exon; INSPIRE' THEN 'exon; INSPIRE' ELSE 'Other' END AS data_source, r, variant WITH data_source, COLLECT({snp: id(variant), credible_set_id: r.credible_set, data_source: r.data_source, pip: r.pip, n_snp: r.n_snp, purity: r.purity, nominal_p: r.nominal_p, lbf: r.lbf, effect_allele: r.effect_allele}) AS credible_sets RETURN data_source, credible_sets ORDER BY data_source;
general - relationship - specific.question_for_result: How does the {SNP @snp_id@} influence the expression of {@gene_symbol@} in @tissue@ tissue, as reported by @method@?
general - relationship - specific.cypher_for_result_page_core: MATCH (variant:sequence_variant:snp), (gene:coding_elements) WHERE ID(variant) = '@snp@' AND ID(gene) = '@gene@' MATCH (variant)-[r:fine_mapped_eQTL]-(gene) WITH collect(DISTINCT variant) + collect(DISTINCT gene) AS nodes, collect(DISTINCT r) AS edges RETURN { results: [ { nodes: nodes, edges: edges } ] } AS output;
general - relationship - specific.cypher_for_result_page_nbr: MATCH (variant:sequence_variant)-[r1]-(nbr1) WHERE ID(variant) = '@snp@' WITH r1, nbr1 MATCH (gene:coding_elements)-[r2]-(nbr2) WHERE ID(gene) = '@gene@'WITH collect(DISTINCT r1) + collect(DISTINCT r2) AS rels, collect(DISTINCT nbr1) + collect(DISTINCT nbr2) AS nbrs WITH rels, [n IN nbrs WHERE NOT id(n) IN ['@snp@','@gene@']] AS nodes RETURN { results: [ { nodes: nodes, edges: rels } ] } AS output;

question: What is {@gene_symbol@}’s expression level in {@cell_type_name@ (@cell_type_id@)} and its link to {T1D}?
specific - relationship - specific.question_for_result: What is {@gene_symbol@}’s expression level in {@cell_type_name@ (@cell_type_id@)} and its link to {T1D}?
specific - relationship - specific.cypher_for_result_page_core: MATCH (g:gene {id: '@gene@'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[r1:expression_level]->(c1:cell_type) OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[r4:Differential_Expression]->(c2:cell_type) OPTIONAL MATCH (o:OCR)-[r2:OCR_locate_in]->(g) OPTIONAL MATCH (o)-[r3:OCR_activity]->(c2) WITH collect(DISTINCT g) AS g_nodes, collect(DISTINCT c1) AS c1_nodes, collect(DISTINCT c2) AS c2_nodes, collect(DISTINCT o) AS o_nodes, collect(DISTINCT r1) AS r1_edges, collect(DISTINCT r2) AS r2_edges, collect(DISTINCT r3) AS r3_edges, collect(DISTINCT r4) AS r4_edges WITH g_nodes + c1_nodes + c2_nodes + o_nodes AS all_nodes, r1_edges + r2_edges + r3_edges + r4_edges AS all_edges WITH [n IN all_nodes WHERE n IS NOT NULL] AS nodes, [e IN all_edges WHERE e IS NOT NULL] AS edges RETURN { results: [{ nodes: nodes, edges: edges }] } AS output
specific - relationship - specific.cypher_for_result_page_nbr: MATCH (g:gene)-[r1]-(nbr1) WHERE g.id = '@gene@' WITH collect(DISTINCT r1) AS rels, collect(DISTINCT nbr1) AS nbrs WITH rels, [n IN nbrs WHERE NOT n.id IN ['@gene@']] AS filtered_nbrs WITH rels, head(filtered_nbrs) AS one_node WHERE one_node IS NOT NULL WITH rels, [one_node] AS nodes RETURN { results: [ { nodes: nodes, edges: rels } ] } AS output
